address: 160 Piccadilly, St James’s, London, W1J 9EB, United Kingdom
bio: Like the other restaurants in this group, The Wolseley serves classic European dishes in an elegant setting with a buzzing atmosphere – well-organised service ensures that everything runs like clockwork even in a packed dining room. The extensive menu features top quality seafood dishes, from clams and oysters to crevettes and caviar. The sweet-toothed among you will not be disappointed by a large dessert menu that includes apple strudel and a choice of coupes....
